verdict.rationale: Blink is a full SSH/Mosh terminal that lets developers connect to remote servers (or use commands like scp/sftp) and thus run git commit/push commands on the remote shell, and it also integrates with VS Code/Codespaces/GitPod workflows. However, there's no direct evidence of built-in git tooling or local git support—developers must rely on a remote shell environment with git installed rather than a native git workflow on-device.
